toegepas.voor: naby die werk en die dorp
toegepas.na: naby die werk, en die dorp
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two full clauses ('Mense kom bly' / 'die dorp groei'); without it 'naby die werk en die dorp' misreads as near the work and the town.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Required AWS comma that also removes a garden-path reading; meaning unchanged.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'rondom' says 'around' unambiguously; bare 'om' can read as 'in order to'.
toegepas.fout: Bare 'om' for 'around' is loose here and less clear than 'rondom'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'rondom' states the same spatial sense (the town grows around the work) more clearly and matches changes 3 and 4.

toegepas.voor: Kimberley het om diamante ontstaan en Johannesburg om die goud
toegepas.na: Kimberley het rondom diamante ontstaan en Johannesburg rondom die goud
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'ontstaan om' is awkward and ambiguous; 'rondom' gives the intended 'around'.
toegepas.fout: 'het om diamante ontstaan' is awkward Afrikaans.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'rondom' keeps the same meaning (the towns arose around the diamonds and the gold) and reads naturally.

toegepas.voor: Winkels en huise en skole het om die myne gegroei
toegepas.na: Winkels, huise en skole het rondom die myne gegroei
toegepas.rede_vinder: A list reads more naturally with commas than repeated 'en', and 'rondom' is clearer than 'om'.
toegepas.fout: Repeated 'en' in a list reads wooden, and 'om' is less clear than 'rondom'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Same three items and same meaning, in a natural list form with the clearer preposition.

toegepas.voor: die land in en uit gaan
toegepas.rede_vinder: With a postposition the verb is written together, so the short form is 'in- en uitgaan'.
toegepas.fout: Spelling: with the postposition 'die land in/uit' the verb is written together ('ingaan', 'uitgaan').
toegepas.rede_keurder: Spelling correction to 'in- en uitgaan'; meaning unchanged.

toegepas.voor: Ons noem so 'n verskuiwing 'n gedwonge verskuiwing.
toegepas.rede_vinder: Avoids the wooden repetition of 'verskuiwing' while keeping the term.
toegepas.fout: 'so 'n verskuiwing 'n gedwonge verskuiwing' repeats the noun woodenly, and the sentence before speaks of 'wegtrek', not 'verskuiwing'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'dit' points clearly to the forced moving just described and the term 'gedwonge verskuiwing' stays intact.

toegepas.voor: waar mense woon en nie die water
toegepas.na: waar mense woon, nie die water
toegepas.rede_vinder: With 'en' the contrast can be misread as part of the 'waar' clause; a comma makes clear the law, not water or climate, decided.
toegepas.fout: With 'en' the contrast can be read as part of the 'waar' clause.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma makes clear that the law, not water or climate, decided; who decides what is unchanged.

toegepas.voor: huise en winkels en fabrieke en paaie
toegepas.rede_vinder: A list reads more naturally with commas than repeated 'en'.
toegepas.fout: Four items joined by repeated 'en' read wooden.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Same four items in a natural list form; meaning unchanged.

toegepas.voor: hul gevolg is nie weg nie
toegepas.na: hul gevolge is nie weg nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: The consequences of laws are naturally plural in Afrikaans ('gevolge').
toegepas.fout: Singular 'gevolg' is unnatural here, and the next sentences name several consequences.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Plural 'gevolge' is the natural Afrikaans and fits the several effects that follow.

laat_vaar.voor: die vangs afgelaai en verwerk word
laat_vaar.na: die vangs afgelaai en verwerk kan word
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The modal 'kan' of the first part should carry into the parallel passive clause.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The original passive clause is grammatical, and adding 'kan' changes a statement into a possibility for no clear gain.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'ontstaan' is the standard word for a town coming into being and matches the rest of the lesson.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'opgekom' is natural Afrikaans for towns springing up, so 'ontstaan' is a lateral swap.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'dra ... vorm' is an unnatural calque; towns 'het' a shape.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'dra nog daardie vorm' is acceptable Afrikaans and carries the sense of bearing a past imprint, which plain 'het' loses.

na_skrywer.rede_vinder: Without the comma 'wat' clearly refers to the area, not to the government.
na_skrywer.fout: The comma before 'wat' lets 'wat' be read as referring to the government rather than to the area.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: A real ambiguity, but this is a glossary definition and removing the comma makes the clause restrictive, so the writer must fix it for every lesson while keeping 'die plaaslike regering van 'n gebied' intact.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer
